comparison.objective: Park a radial drill arm without the spindle hitting table parts; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated machine-arm positioning with obstacle avoidance versus unlocking, fine rotary adjustment, relocking and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Arm parked collision-free versus repeated energy absorption within stroke, rebound and retention limits.
comparison.reason: Avoiding collision during parking does not test damper-setting manipulation or dynamic stop quality. Parking pose and clearance rubric are missing.
